---
title: "CM class distribution among passing hits — 260807 75x75 trueRef"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Desktop/viromelib/figures/flaviLib")
```

## Config

```{r paths}
csv10 <- "inputs/flaviLib_10mM_1234_peaks_annotated20260826_allCMs.csv"
csv01 <- "inputs/flaviLib_01mM_1234_peaks_annotated20260826_allCMs.csv"
fig_dir <- "plots/CMdist/20260826_allCMs"
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# This run only searched classes 1a, 1b, 2 (3 and 4 skipped -- expected
# absent from this library, see project notes). Priority order for
# assigning a single class label when multiple hit (1a > 1b > 2).
CM_COLS <- c(
  "Class 1a" = "CL_Class_1a_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  "Class 1b" = "CL_Class_1b_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  "Class 2"  = "CL_Class_2_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  "Dumbbell" = "dumbbell_RF00525.cm_hit"
)

# Combined across 4 replicates (--labels R1 R2 R3 R4 in combine_replicates.py).
# A site needs to have passed in at least this many replicates to count as
# "detected" here -- adjust and re-knit if a different bar is wanted.
MIN_REPS_PASSING <- 2
```

## Load & classify

```{r load}
d10 <- read_csv(csv10, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(condition = "10 mM Mg")
d01 <- read_csv(csv01, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(condition = "1 mM Mg")

dat <- bind_rows(d10, d01) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("10 mM Mg", "1 mM Mg")),
    family = if_else(is.na(family) | family == "" | family == "Unannotated",
                      "Unannotated", family),
    genus  = if_else(is.na(genus) | genus == "" | genus == "Unannotated",
                      "Unannotated", genus)
  )

cat("Total candidate sites (10 mM):", nrow(d10), "\n")
cat("Total candidate sites (1 mM): ", nrow(d01), "\n")
```

```{r classify}
# priority-ordered CM class assignment, same convention as fig1A_v4_addCM.Rmd
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    cm_class = case_when(
      !is.na(.data[[CM_COLS["Class 1a"]]])   ~ "cl1a xrRNA",
      !is.na(.data[[CM_COLS["Class 1b"]]])   ~ "cl1b xrRNA",
      !is.na(.data[[CM_COLS["Class 2"]]])    ~ "cl2 xrRNA",
      !is.na(.data[[CM_COLS["Dumbbell"]]])   ~ "Dumbbell",
      TRUE                                    ~ "Unclassified"
    ),
    cm_class = factor(cm_class,
                       levels = c("cl1a xrRNA", "cl1b xrRNA", "cl2 xrRNA", "Dumbbell", "Unclassified"))
  )
```

## Restrict to passing sites, one row per accession

```{r filter-passing}
passing <- dat %>%
  filter(n_reps_passing >= MIN_REPS_PASSING)

cat("Passing sites (n_reps_passing >=", MIN_REPS_PASSING, "):", nrow(passing), "\n")

# one row per accession per condition -- keep its best-supported passing site
det_accs <- passing %>%
  group_by(condition, accession) %>%
  slice_max(n_reps_passing, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Unique detected accessions:\n")
det_accs %>% count(condition)
```

## CM class distribution

```{r cm_summary}
det_accs %>%
  count(condition, cm_class) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```

```{r palette}
cm_colors <- c(
  "cl1a xrRNA"  = "#1A5FA8",
  "cl1b xrRNA"  = "#4EA8DE",
  "cl2 xrRNA"   = "#F4A11D",
  "Dumbbell"    = "#5DAD6F",
  "Unclassified" = "#C8C8C8"
)
```

## Figure — CM class distribution (counts)

```{r fig_counts, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
p_counts <- det_accs %>%
  count(condition, cm_class) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cm_class, y = n, fill = cm_class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~condition, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cm_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(
    title = "CM class distribution among detected accessions",
    subtitle = paste0("n_reps_passing >= ", MIN_REPS_PASSING, " of 4 replicates"),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of accessions"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F0F0", colour = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10)
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "cm_class_distribution_counts.pdf"), p_counts, width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "cm_class_distribution_counts.svg"), p_counts, width = 7, height = 5)
p_counts
```

## Figure — CM class distribution (proportion)

```{r fig_prop, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
p_prop <- det_accs %>%
  count(condition, cm_class) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = n, fill = cm_class)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.6, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cm_colors, name = "CM class") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    title = "CM class composition among detected accessions",
    subtitle = paste0("n_reps_passing >= ", MIN_REPS_PASSING, " of 4 replicates"),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of accessions"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10)
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "cm_class_distribution_proportion.pdf"), p_prop, width = 6, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "cm_class_distribution_proportion.svg"), p_prop, width = 6, height = 5)
p_prop
```

## By genus (top genera only)

```{r fig_genus, fig.width=13, fig.height=6}
MIN_GENUS_N <- 5

genus_keep <- det_accs %>% count(genus) %>% filter(n >= MIN_GENUS_N) %>% pull(genus)
genus_order <- det_accs %>% filter(genus %in% genus_keep) %>%
  count(genus) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(genus)

genus_summary <- det_accs %>%
  filter(genus %in% genus_keep) %>%
  mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = genus_order)) %>%
  count(genus, cm_class, condition) %>%
  complete(genus, cm_class, condition, fill = list(n = 0))

p_genus <- ggplot(genus_summary, aes(x = genus, y = n, fill = cm_class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, colour = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~condition, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cm_colors, name = "CM class") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title = "CM class by viral genus",
    subtitle = paste0("Genera with >= ", MIN_GENUS_N, " detected accessions | n_reps_passing >= ", MIN_REPS_PASSING),
    x = "Viral genus",
    y = "Number of accessions"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F0F0", colour = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10)
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "cm_class_by_genus.pdf"), p_genus, width = 13, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "cm_class_by_genus.svg"), p_genus, width = 13, height = 6)
p_genus
```

## Notes

- `MIN_REPS_PASSING = 2` (of 4) is a starting assumption, not a value carried
  over from prior analysis -- the earlier 3-replicate pipeline
  (`fig1A_v4_addCM.Rmd`) used `MIN_REPS = 2` of 3, a stricter *fraction*
  (67%) than 2-of-4 (50%). Consider raising to 3 of 4 if you want a
  comparably strict bar, or keep 2 of 4 if you'd rather match the prior
  *absolute* replicate count.
- CM classes 3 and 4 were not searched in this run (skipped per project
  decision -- see run notes) and are not part of the classification here.
  If they're added later, extend `CM_COLS` and the `cm_class` factor
  levels accordingly.
- Class assignment is priority-ordered (1a > 1b > 2); an accession with
  hits in multiple classes is labelled by the highest-priority one only.
